author: Cleep
changelog:
## [1.0.0] - 2026-09-01

### Added
- Add MQTT bridge module with publish, subscribe, unsubscribe and settings commands
- Emit mqtt.message.received events for subscribed MQTT messages
- Optional forwarding of Cleep events to MQTT topics
- Add simple configuration UI
label: MQTT
longdescription: Connects Cleep to an MQTT broker. Other modules can publish MQTT messages through this module, and incoming MQTT messages are exposed as Cleep events.
